bmd_ratio.label: BMD ratio
bmd_ratio.why: {label} is {pct} of your baseline ({date}), below the {lower}% limit. This is a possible bone loss, not a diagnosis.
bmd_ratio.action: Tell the flight surgeon at the next contact and follow their advice. Do not change your exercise or diet plan on your own.

watch.why: {label} is {pct} of your baseline ({date}), within the {lower}% to {upper}% band. This is an early sign of possible bone loss.
watch.action: Keep to the planned exercise, re-measure as scheduled and mention it to the flight surgeon.

normal.why: {label} is {pct} of your baseline ({date}), above the {upper}% limit.
normal.action: Keep to the planned exercise. The flight surgeon reviews the trend at routine contacts.

no_data.why: No {label} baseline is set in the BMD and strength tracker yet, so no comparison is made.
no_data.action: Set your baseline in the BMD and strength tracker. Ask the flight surgeon if you are unsure which values to use.

bmd_ratio.howToMeasure: Enter the hip and lumbar spine BMD values in g/cm² from your scan report in the BMD and strength tracker. The first entry marked as baseline is the reference.
bmd_ratio.whyItMatters: Bone mineral density can fall in weightlessness. Comparing each scan with your own baseline shows a possible loss early.
bmd_ratio.source: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1 Rev C (V1 4027: hip and spine BMD at or above 95% of pre-mission values); the 98% limit, point weights and urgency cut-offs are design values

strength_ratio.label: Strength ratio
strength_ratio.why: {label} is {pct} of your baseline ({date}), below the {lower}% limit. This is a possible loss of muscle strength, not a diagnosis.
strength_ratio.action: Tell the flight surgeon at the next contact and follow their advice. Do not change your exercise or diet plan on your own.

watch.why: {label} is {pct} of your baseline ({date}), within the {lower}% to {upper}% band. This is an early sign of possible loss of muscle strength.
watch.action: Keep to the planned exercise, re-measure as scheduled and mention it to the flight surgeon.

normal.why: {label} is {pct} of your baseline ({date}), above the {upper}% limit.
normal.action: Keep to the planned exercise. The flight surgeon reviews the trend at routine contacts.

no_data.why: No {label} baseline is set in the BMD and strength tracker yet, so no comparison is made.
no_data.action: Set your baseline in the BMD and strength tracker. Ask the flight surgeon if you are unsure which values to use.

strength_ratio.howToMeasure: Log a consistent lift, such as a tested one-rep max for deadlift and bench press, in the BMD and strength tracker.
strength_ratio.whyItMatters: Muscle strength can fall in weightlessness. A drop against your own baseline is an early sign to review training.
strength_ratio.source: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1 Rev C (V1 4024: strength at or above 80% of baseline); the 90% limit, point weights and urgency cut-offs are design values

missed_training_days.label: Missed training days
missed_training_days.why: {missed} unchecked {type} training day{plural} this week, up to today. Missed training is a possible risk to bone and muscle.
missed_training_days.action: Talk to the flight surgeon about the training plan. Do not try to make up all missed sessions at once.

watch.why: {missed} unchecked {type} training day{plural} this week, up to today. Missed training is a possible early risk to bone and muscle.
watch.action: Plan the next sessions this week and mention it to the flight surgeon if it continues.

normal.why: {missed} unchecked {type} training day{plural} this week, up to today.
normal.action: Keep to the planned training. The flight surgeon reviews it at routine contacts.

no_data.why: No {type} training has been logged in the BMD and strength tracker yet.
no_data.action: Log completed training in the BMD and strength tracker. The flight surgeon reviews it at routine contacts.

missed_training_days.howToMeasure: Tick each day's strength and endurance training in the weekly table of the BMD and strength tracker. Only days up to today count.
missed_training_days.whyItMatters: Regular resistance and endurance exercise is the main way to protect bone and muscle on a long mission.
